basics.name: Ashish Bhatiya
basics.label: VP Platform Engineering | Director / Sr Director Engineering Roles | Kubernetes, Observability, AI/ML Platforms
basics.summary: Engineering leader with {{YEARS_EXPERIENCE}}+ years in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, and large-scale distributed systems across banking, fintech, and enterprise environments. Currently VP - Platform Engineering (Director of Engineering scope) at HDFC Bank, leading standardization across platform products (Kubernetes), messaging systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, NATS.io), and observability (OTLP) for platforms serving 100M+ customers, managing 20+ direct reports, influencing 250+ engineers, and owning $1-5M annual CAPEX/OPEX budgets.

work.name: HDFC Bank
highlights: Lead platform engineering for Kubernetes-based banking platforms serving 100M+ customers, managing 20+ direct reports and influencing a 250+ engineer organization on a $1-5M annual CAPEX/OPEX budget
Drove Kubernetes-based, vendor-neutral platform modernization focused on resiliency, disaster recovery, and observability
Built in-house observability platforms on OpenTelemetry, cutting annual tooling costs from $1.2M to $300K
Own hiring strategy, workforce planning, performance management, and succession planning for platform engineering teams
Chair architecture reviews and drive technology governance, risk assessment, and vendor evaluation for regulated banking platforms, ensuring alignment with ISO, SOC, and PCI compliance requirements

work.name: ForaySoft (Contract to Wayfair)
highlights: Guided machine learning engineering efforts to modernize data and ML pipelines supporting large-scale retail analytics for a 5M x 1B SKU matching and pricing-intelligence problem, improving model reliability, scalability, and deployment processes

work.name: PayPal
highlights: Managed globally distributed teams across India and the US, delivering an organization-wide Secrets Scanning platform across 50,000+ repositories

Designed and implemented a Security Data Lake supporting real-time and batch analytics, data curation, and reporting, aligning security architecture and compliance requirements with global stakeholders

work.name: Walmart Labs
highlights: Designed and built high-throughput data pipelines processing 12M+ transactions per day using Apache Spark, Airflow, Cassandra, Python, and Scala, replacing legacy pipelines and improving data reliability

work.name: Barclays
highlights: Developed enterprise-scale data ingestion and stream processing frameworks for 20M customers using Kafka Connect and Apache Spark

work.name: Cisco Systems
highlights: Led migration and performance-tuning initiatives with impact exceeding $13M, and built analytics dashboards supporting $50M+ in transactions for regional sales teams
